OrderFlow.title: What happens after you order?
OrderFlow.introduction: Restaurant confirmation comes first. You pay only after your order is accepted and the delivery fee is added.
OrderFlow.reviewDescription: Send your order for a staff member to manually accept or decline.
OrderFlow.declinedDescription: If declined, you’ll receive a notification. Staff can include a reason, such as an unavailable dish or a busy kitchen. No payment is taken.
OrderFlow.deliveryDescription: Once accepted, Wolt Drive provides the delivery fee. Your order updates with the full amount, including delivery, before you pay.
OrderFlow.paymentDescription: After payment, a courier heads to the restaurant and the kitchen starts preparing your order.
OrderFlow.trackingDescription: You’ll receive a Wolt Drive tracking link to follow your courier and delivery.
OrderFlow.previewNotice: This is the planned ordering flow. Checkout is currently a demo. Orders, staff notifications, payments, and Wolt Drive are not connected yet.

PendingOrders.title: Pending orders
PendingOrders.awaitingConfirmation: Awaiting the restaurant’s acceptance or decline. Payment comes after acceptance and confirmation of the delivery fee.
PendingOrders.deliveryPending: Delivery costs extra. The delivery fee and final total will appear after the restaurant confirms your order, before payment.
PendingOrders.emptyDescription: Complete checkout to see your submitted order and its confirmation status here.
PendingOrders.demoNotice: Preview data. Orders, updates, and notes reset on reload. No real order or payment is processed.
PendingOrders.sampleEstimate: Sample delivery fee and duration for this demo. Final pricing is confirmed before payment.
PendingOrders.onTheWayDescription: The courier is on the way with your order. The arrival time is an estimate.
PendingOrders.confirmationAlert: The restaurant accepted order {number}. Review the delivery fee and confirm the updated total.
PendingOrders.reconfirmDescription: The restaurant accepted your order. Review the delivery cost and full total, then confirm before proceeding to payment.
PendingOrders.confirmedDescription: You confirmed the updated total. Payment will be available when checkout is connected.
PendingOrders.deliveredDescription: This order was delivered. Thank you for ordering with us.
PendingOrders.notificationPrompt: Allow this website to notify you when your order needs confirmation?
PendingOrders.notificationsDeclined: You declined notifications. We’ll notify you here once your order is confirmed. You can ask again whenever you’re ready.
PendingOrders.notificationsDeclinedShort: You declined notifications. We’ll notify you here once your order is confirmed.
PendingOrders.confirmationPosition: {current}/{total} · {count, plural, one {# needs confirmation} other {# need confirmation}}
PendingOrders.notificationsSettings: Your browser is blocking notifications. Allow them in this website’s browser settings, then select Ask again.
PendingOrders.notificationsFirefoxStep1: Click the permissions icon to the left of the website address.
PendingOrders.notificationsFirefoxStep2: Find Send notifications. Click the × beside Blocked to clear that permission.
PendingOrders.notificationsChromeStep1: Click the site controls icon to the left of the address, then Site settings.
PendingOrders.notificationsChromeStep2: Find Notifications and select Allow for this website.
PendingOrders.notificationsEdgeStep1: Click View site information to the left of the website address.
PendingOrders.notificationsEdgeStep2: Under Permissions for this site, change Notifications to Allow.
PendingOrders.notificationsSafariStep2: Choose Allow beside this website. Enable Allow websites to ask for permission if it is switched off.
PendingOrders.notificationsOtherStep1: Open this website’s permissions using the icon beside its address or your browser settings.
PendingOrders.notificationsOtherStep2: Find Notifications and change this website’s permission to Allow.
PendingOrders.notificationsReturnStep: Return here and click Ask again. If a permission prompt opens, choose Allow.
PendingOrders.notificationsUnsupported: Notifications aren’t available in this browser or connection. You can still follow your order on this page.
